scope: Retrospective within-session feedback-aligned fixed-window sensitivity; not prospective, causal, absence or new-animal inference.

source.representation: Published processed NWB, not raw voltages; all released clusters, not quality-selected single neurons.
source.outcome_semantics: Released Boolean is_mouse_rewarded; upstream feedbackType == 1.0 mapping. Original unknown feedback codes cannot be reconstructed; not independent physical water-delivery measurement.

source_validation.trial_and_unit_ids: unique signed-int64-compatible original IDs, preserve positional rows separately
source_validation.reward: Require original Boolean dtype; never cast missing or arbitrary codes to error.
source_validation.spikes: One ragged train per original unit, nonnegative finite nondecreasing float64 seconds; repeated timestamps count separately. Index must be nondecreasing nonnegative integral, last equals spike_times length.
source_validation.clock: session_start_time and timestamps_reference_time equal; source seconds unchanged
source_validation.unit_policy: all released unit rows, no quality/region/rate/rank selection, no re-sorting
source_validation.observation_support: unknown: no Units observation intervals or invalid_times in this released file. Count stored occurrences, including zeros; do not infer continuous recording coverage from spike extrema.
source_validation.task_epoch: Report source task epoch and window overlap descriptively, not as proof of unit observation or additional exclusion.

selection.eligibility: finite stimulus onset AND finite feedback AND choice exactly clockwise or counter_clockwise
selection.class_balance: k=min(number eligible label1,number eligible label0); k>=5; choose k from each class
selection.draw_order: eligible source rows in ascending positional order; choice(label1,k,replace=False), then choice(label0,k,replace=False) using same RNG, including full-minority draw; concatenate then sort selected source row positions
selection.folds: separate StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=True,random_state=0) on selected chronological labels; fold IDs0..4 identical across all analyses

counting.arithmetic: float64(original feedback)+float64(integer milliseconds/1000), independently for each endpoint; no rounding feedback, no cumulative floating arange
counting.features: integer spike occurrence counts, not rates; every selected trial and every released unit in every window
counting.boundary_rule: left included, right excluded, duplicate occurrences preserved
counting.missing_coverage: no coverage-based exclusions or imputation; unknown continuous observation explicitly disclosed

model.scaling: train-only arithmetic mean and population variance separately per analysis/fold; StandardScaler numerical-constant test var <= n*eps*var+(n*mean*eps)^2 (eps=float64 epsilon); constant scale=1, otherwise sqrt(var)
model.equivalent_implementations: Any finite optimizer meeting the same objective and mean-objective gradient infinity <=1e-9; raw termination/warnings must be preserved, no exact iteration/status gate.
model.classification: decision_score > 0 => rewarded1, otherwise0; zero ties label0
model.rank: U>N and rank-deficient features are allowed; no rank-based exclusions or extra regularization

statistics.mean_accuracy: unweighted arithmetic mean of five fold accuracies
statistics.accuracy_sd: population SD (ddof=0) of five fold accuracies, descriptive not CI
statistics.pooled_oof_accuracy: total correct/all selected trials; separately named
statistics.pre_post_gap: control_post mean_accuracy minus headline_pre mean_accuracy, descriptive with unequal widths
statistics.performance_gate: none: no expected sign, accuracy interval, profile correlation, significance, equivalence or required post-control success

tolerances.integer_identity_and_counts: exact values; finite integral CSV scientific notation allowed; not bool/fraction/nonfinite
tolerances.near_zero_rule: Accepted scores may change sign within score tolerance; prediction must follow submitted score and every summary recomputes from submitted predictions.

source_trials.csv.missing: nonfinite source time or unselected fold serialized empty; eligibility/selection/rewarded explicit0/1

spike_counts.npz.format: primitive arrays only; allow_pickle=False; no object or pickle; nonnegative integer counts; axis order free if consistently labeled

results.json.analyses: list of21 same four-field objects; unique analysis IDs; order free

run_metadata.json.source: exact source object from this public contract
run_metadata.json.method: entire parsed public method_contract JSON, no contradictory nested additions

source_summary.quality_counts: objects keyed by source label / str(float(score)); no quality exclusion

run_metadata.json.support_by_analysis: 21 objects keyed by analysis with n_starts_before_trial_start,n_ends_after_trial_stop,n_starts_before_stimulus,n_ends_after_choice_registration,n_starts_before_task_epoch,n_ends_after_task_epoch,n_overlapping_selected_window_pairs; compare unrounded source times, half-open overlap positive length, each unordered selected-trial pair once; descriptive not exclusions
run_metadata.json.fits: 105 unique analysis/fold objects: mean_gradient_inf finite >=0 <=1e-9; finite_parameters true; optimizer_status JSON string or number preserving raw status; warnings list of strings. Optional extra optimizer diagnostics allowed.
run_metadata.json.software: nonempty map of nonempty implementation/version strings; truthful alternative implementations accepted

findings.md.requirement: nonempty readable scientific summary, no keywords graded

serialization: CSV row/column order and consistently labeled NPZ axes may vary; JSON extra top-level descriptions accepted. Required identity/method/source maps must not conflict. Summary floats finite; bool not numeric. No requirement for hardcoded prose or source accuracy. Output directory must contain these eight artifacts.
interpretation_limits: one mouse/session, folds and clusters not biological replicates
released clusters mostly MUA; no well-isolated-neuron claim
retrospective feedback alignment is not online prediction
different window widths confound pure timing comparison
random within-session folds do not establish forward-time/new-session/new-animal generalization
balanced subset is not natural-prevalence deployment evaluation
point accuracy and fold SD do not establish absence/significance/causality
Nature2025 Fig6 uses regional quality-selected cohort, post200ms, L1/class weights/balanced accuracy/nested CV/nulls; this is an adaptation, not that finding
